description: This file declares the interface for the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService and its factory within the Rialto server IPC layer. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to media pipeline capabilities and MIME type support.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService interface, managing media pipeline capabilities and MIME type support.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService instance.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported MIME types.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific MIME type is supported.
